acceptanceCriteria: Each admitted server method and position encoding is negotiated, bounded and reported with its exact executable/config/version identity; unsupported methods and layouts are explicit.
Go real-workspace no-package-metadata and unavailable-reason paths have the evidence required by V1-0168 and V1-0167; a loaded server with no useful semantic data is not silently promoted.
Missing dependencies, no network/downloads/install, malformed URIs/ranges, hostile output, cancellation and descendant/cache cleanup have focused and live conformance evidence.
Every newly supported language/server/workspace tuple passes its declared live qualification with default Core behavior and authority unchanged.
body:
Parent V1-0477. Extend the current Go/gopls provider through explicit negotiated, pinned adapter profiles. Reuse V1-0168 workspace-loading and V1-0167 error-redaction issues. Additional languages are enabled only after stage 1 selects exact tuples; TypeScript and Python are candidates, not an accepted order.

2026-09-29 experimental component progress: isolated native-Go caller-owned gopls session candidate36759d1203bdc303266195d848951076ed4f5201 passed focused race/vet/documentation checks and one live gopls0.23.0 unsaved-overlay definition witness. Independent review /tmp/gopls-session-independent-review.md found no actionable defects. UTF16 definition-only, synchronized open source/target overlays; caller identity is not Git authority. Final CEM, integrated editor checks, broader methods/layouts, promotion, dependencies and native completion remain pending. No support tuple promoted.
title: LSP quality: negotiate and qualify upstream adapters
